build_detr_model: build a DETR object detection model from a Detectron2 config with HungarianMatcher and SetCriterion
run_detr_forward: run the Detr forward pass on batched inputs to compute training losses or inference results
create_detr_inference: create object detection predictions by running inference on box classification and box regression outputs
refactor_detr_preprocess: refactor the Detr preprocess_image method to normalize, pad, and batch input images into an ImageList
review_detr_prepare_targets: review the Detr prepare_targets method that converts ground truth instances to normalized label and box tensors
